name: What permits are required for new home construction in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for new home construction in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: New home construction in Southern California typically requires a range of permits from local city or county building departments. These often include building permits, grading permits, electrical permits, plumbing permits, and mechanical permits. Depending on the location and project specifics, additional permits for zoning, environmental impact, or specialized systems may be necessary.
